name: Navalmanzano (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Navalmanzano (a wavy bend and an apple tree on yellow, a horse's head on white).
history: Navalmanzano adopted its arms and flag officially on 10 June 1999, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 30 June 1999; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms in its colours.
